message.reasoning: We need to convert 10 liters to gallons? Actually we have 10 liters currently. We want to fill to full capacity. Fuel tank holds up to 50 gallons. But we need to know how many gallons to add. We have 10 liters. Convert to gallons: 1 liter ≈ 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters ≈ 2.64172 gallons. So we need to fill 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. Use gallon_to_liter conversion? Actually we need to call gallon_to_liter? Wait we need to fill fuel tank with amount in gallons. We need to provide fuelAmount in gallons. So we need to compute gallons to add. Let's do calculation: 10 liters * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. Then 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. We'll round maybe to 47.36 gallons. Then call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount: 47.36.
